name: Keystone Snap
description: Snap the keystone of a foe's array so that every line in it goes slack at once.

name: Burst Ring
description: Overload a drawn ring until it bursts outward in a flat violent wave.

name: Strained Hold
description: Hold an array past its limit so that its pressure on the foe grows until the lines creak.

name: Anchor Ram
description: Drive a charged anchor through the foe's guard so that it bursts inside the blow.

name: Stressed Array
description: Lay an array loaded past its safe charge so that it flies apart when a foe touches it.

name: Fracture Matrix
description: Hold a matrix that cracks along its lines and throws shards of force across the ground.

name: Brittle Ward
description: Raise a ward made to shatter on a blow and throw the force back in splinters.

name: Overload Plate
description: Overload a guard plate with qi until it holds the blow and then bursts outward.

name: Collapse Draw
description: Draw a foe's whole attack into a failing array and let the array swallow it as it falls.

name: Rupture Flash
description: Blow a gap through the ground between two marks and flash across it before the gap closes.

name: Unmaking Seal
description: Seal a foe's array with a mark that unmakes each line it touches.

name: Drawing Matrix
description: Lay a matrix with the centre cut away so that every foe that nears it is pulled in and pressed down.

name: Keystone Ruin
description: Break the keystone of a great laid array so that all its stored charge rends the ground to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Grand Collapse
description: Turn a whole formation inward and let it fall upon itself with the full destructive ceiling of its tier.
